messages:
Maya (CS): FYI incoming - several onboarding customers reported that embeddings failed to appear in search results and some API calls returned 502/503 between 2026-03-22T09:12Z and 09:32Z. We need a concise customer-facing status update and a plan for offering make-good credits + enablement office hours. Can Eng confirm the current status?
Diego (Eng): Triage notes: regression introduced by a mismatched schema in the batch-ingest worker config during a midnight deploy. Worker tried to write shards with incompatible header -> downstream validator rejected writes causing retries and service overload. Mitigation: paused batch workers, started backfills for affected batches. Current backfill progress ~60%.
Sana (SRE): We've put the cluster into degraded mode and disabled autoscaling to prevent additional noisy retries. Observability: https://internal.metrics/embeds/batches/460012. Expected time to full catch-up ~3-5 hours depending on peak. No evidence of data loss or exposure.
Ruth (AM): I'll prepare a personalized message for enterprise trials and renewals. Proposed language: 'We're currently mitigating an ingestion regression impacting embeddings for a subset of accounts. Engineering has enacted a mitigation and is performing backfills. We will provide a detailed RCA within 48 hours and are offering credits and a dedicated enablement session.' Need final wording and confirmation on credit amount.
Maya (CS): Draft looks good. Recommend offering 10% of that billing cycle (min $100) for affected customers + 1:1 enablement. Also ask customers to share failing request payloads or job ids to help triage.
Diego (Eng): Agree. Also include this quick customer test to confirm success after remediation: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"sample"}' | jq '.status'``` expecting "ok".
NotifBot: Backfill job update: job-id=bf-4600-22 progress=62% ETA=02:40:00
Maya (CS): Action items: 1) Ruth send tailored comms to top 8 impacted accounts 2) CS open feedback sheet and paste any payloads https://docs.internal/cs/inc-460012-feedback 3) SRE to post final reconfirm when backfills complete. I'll set up office hours invite for 2x sessions this week.
Ruth (AM): Sending now. Will post customer replies to this thread.
Maya (CS): Thanks. Also tag renewals leads for accounts with contract renewals in the next 60 days.
